title: finite graph topological order — case 1
hypothesis: A finite DAG can produce a deterministic lexicographic topological order while cyclic subjects remain rejectable.
null_or_failure_condition: Unknown or missing fields, invalid node or edge references, nondeterministic ordering, input mutation, failed round trip, external action, or protected-claim promotion is a failed subject with zero success credit.
falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Require a closed deterministic result, unchanged input, exact property witness, retained invalid subject, no external action, and unchanged evidence and authority ceilings.
rollback_or_recovery: Retain the failed subject, stop selecting only the failed operation, repair the smallest dependency, and preserve every earlier witness.
